fileItem-clip.label: Clip
fileItem-clip.tip:
Clip area of icon
$Related command
Load Image

fileItem-inherit.label: Inherit
fileItem-inherit.tip:
Inherits specified item's attributes, events, and scripts
If the same attribute exists, it overrides the inherited item's attribute value
If the same type of event exists, it overrides the inherited item's event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command
However, inherited scripts will stack instead of being overridden

fileItem-attributes.label: Attributes
fileItem-attributes.tip:
Attribute list (readonly)
$Optional types
Boolean, Number, String, Enumeration(String)
$Related commands
Set Boolean, Set Number, Set String

fileItem-events.label: Events
fileItem-events.tip:
A list of item events
Access "Event Trigger Actor" to get the actor that uses this item
Access "Event Trigger Item" to get this item
$Optional types
Use Item: Triggered when the actor uses this item
Custom: Triggered by the "Call Event" command

fileItem-scripts.label: Scripts
fileItem-scripts.tip: Add script files to extend this item
